Harness scope (Claudio): **yes, the test-only change can stay in PR295.** It is the minimum needed for this PR's own CI to finish, so a separate PR isn't required.

It is accepted on these conditions:
- **Change only the server `test` script, nothing else.** Replace `jest --runInBand` with `jest --maxWorkers=1 --workerIdleMemoryLimit=512MB`. Note that `workerIdleMemoryLimit` has no effect under `--runInBand`, which is why the worker change is needed. Leave `jest.config.js` discovery, setup files, global setup/teardown and timeouts unchanged. Leave the CI `NODE_OPTIONS` heap at 8192, with no increase and no `--expose-gc` hooks in tests.
- **Run the same tests.** The fresh CI run must execute the same suite count as your local complete run (362 suites / 5508 tests, plus anything this head adds), with no skips, `.only` or quarantines. Please quote the final Jest summary line.
- **Keep the run serial.** It stays one worker at a time, so the owned-DB ordering assumptions are unchanged.
- **Say it in the PR description.** List it as a test-harness change in PR295's description, with the reason: run 38393187129 ran out of heap (exit 134) after 350 passing suites.

The fresh, complete CI on the new head and my exact-head audit are still required before merge.
